name: SwiftOS
updatePolicy: Compatible signed updates preserve existing private launcher preferences; Android can reject downgrades. Private settings have no complete export interface.
weather: Kolkata only, explicitly optional. Defaults off on other TV models; existing weather behavior is retained on compatible profiles.
compatibility: Android TV / Google TV 8+. Physical remote, startup and playback checks required for each firmware. Android APKs do not run on LG webOS or Samsung Tizen.
